text:
noelle: Quick proposal for a safer periodic admin entitlement cleanup. I built a scoring heuristic to prioritize candidates for manual review + a narrow automation path for low-risk items. Posting to gather feedback before I PR the scan job.

ashwin: link?
noelle: https://redwood-internal/notes/entitlement-scoring-draft (WIP)

noelle: TL;DR: compute a 0-1 score from 3 signals: last_active_ts, permission_breadth (# roles/resources), and blast_radius (kms keys + cross-account bindings). Surface top N each cadence instead of sweeping everyone.

sanjay: we should decay svcacct activity faster (they tend to be transient). also exclude principals linked to open incidence/vuln tickets.

noelle: agreed. plan: svcacct decay factor and an incident tag. we'll consume incident state from our tracker and skip any principal with incident_active=true.

tara: KMS admins worry me — even unused keys can break rotation agents. How do we avoid causing outages?

noelle: KMS-handling: annotate candidates with kms_dependency_count. Auto-prune only when kms_dependency_count==0 and last_access > kms_safe_threshold_days (default 180). Otherwise send to manual checklist that verifies rotation owners and usage audit.

ashwin: prototyped scan command for dry-run: 
```
rbac-scan --org redwood --since 365d --heuristics heuristics.yaml --dry-run --out candidates-1994567890.csv
```

noelle: sample heuristics.yaml excerpt we plan to publish: 
```
weights:
  last_active: 0.5
  permission_breadth: 0.3
  blast_radius: 0.2
filters:
  exclude_tags: ["incident_active", "biz_critical"]
kms_safe_threshold_days: 180
svcacct_decay_days: 90
```

kevin: rollout suggestion: 1) run weekly dry scan x2 weeks and send CSVs to owners; 2) automated offboarding only for score>=0.9 and non-kms, non-crossacct; 3) canary-prune 1% of total admins (off-peak, oncall paged); 4) full rollout after 2 clean canaries.

noelle: rollback mechanics: every automated removal creates a tombstone in identity-store with removed_at + removed_by. undo via identity-restore tool. Example: 
```
identity-restore --tombstone tombstones/1994568001.json
```

sanjay: abort triggers we should wire into the pipeline: any auth_fail_rate > 2x baseline within 1h, rotation-agent errors, or new vuln tickets referencing removed principals.

tara: I will draft the KMS manual-checklist (key owners, rotation agents, cross-account bindings, recent key usage). Who has the rotation-agent inventory?

ashwin: I can emit incident_active tag via webhook from our incident bot to identity-store. ETA 3d.

kevin: I’ll coordinate canary window with on-call (suggest 03:00-05:00 PST) and update the playbook. ETA 4d.

noelle: next action items: ashwin — incident webhook (3d); tara — KMS checklist draft (5d); kevin — canary schedule & playbook (4d); sanjay — add svcacct decay param to heuristics (2d). I’ll open the PR for rbac-scan dry-run + heuristics.yaml after comments.
